enquiries_plot_parent_required.name: enquiries_plot_parent_required
enquiries_plot_parent_required.value: "enquiries"."plot_id" IS NULL OR "enquiries"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

enquiries_contact_consent.name: enquiries_contact_consent
enquiries_contact_consent.value: length(trim("enquiries"."name")) > 0 AND length(trim("enquiries"."consent_version")) > 0 AND (nullif(trim("enquiries"."email"), '') IS NOT NULL OR nullif(trim("enquiries"."phone"), '') IS NOT NULL OR nullif(trim("enquiries"."line_id"), '') IS NOT NULL)

enquiries_target.name: enquiries_target
enquiries_target.value: ("enquiries"."type" <> 'listing' OR ("enquiries"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim("enquiries"."email"), '') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim("enquiries"."phone"), '') IS NOT NULL)) AND ("enquiries"."type" NOT IN ('brochure','site_visit') OR "enquiries"."project_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("enquiries"."type" <> 'site_visit' OR ("enquiries"."preferred_at" IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim("enquiries"."phone"), '') IS NOT NULL))

listing_media_photo_alt.name: listing_media_photo_alt
listing_media_photo_alt.value: "listing_media"."kind" <> 'photo' OR (length(trim("listing_media"."alt_th")) > 0 AND length(trim("listing_media"."alt_en")) > 0 AND "listing_media"."alt_th" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_media"."alt_en" IS NOT NULL)

listings_coordinates.name: listings_coordinates
listings_coordinates.value: ("listings"."lat" IS NULL AND "listings"."lng" IS NULL) OR ("listings"."lat" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."lng" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "listings"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

listings_prices.name: listings_prices
listings_prices.value: ("listings"."price" IS NULL OR "listings"."price" > 0) AND ("listings"."previous_price" IS NULL OR "listings"."previous_price" > 0)

listings_price_intent.name: listings_price_intent
listings_price_intent.value: ("listings"."intent" = 'sale' AND "listings"."price_period" IS NULL) OR ("listings"."intent" = 'rent' AND "listings"."price_period" IS NOT NULL)

listings_publish_required.name: listings_publish_required
listings_publish_required.value: "listings"."publish_state" <> 'published' OR ("listings"."status" <> 'draft' AND "listings"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."description_th" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."description_en" IS NOT NULL AND ("listings"."price_visibility" = 'contact_gated' OR "listings"."price" IS NOT NULL))

listings_nonnegative.name: listings_nonnegative
listings_nonnegative.value: ("listings"."beds" IS NULL OR "listings"."beds" >= 0) AND ("listings"."baths" IS NULL OR "listings"."baths" > 0) AND ("listings"."size_sqm" IS NULL OR "listings"."size_sqm" > 0) AND ("listings"."land_sqwah" IS NULL OR "listings"."land_sqwah" > 0) AND ("listings"."parking" IS NULL OR "listings"."parking" >= 0) AND ("listings"."common_fee_per_sqm" IS NULL OR "listings"."common_fee_per_sqm" >= 0) AND ("listings"."built_year" IS NULL OR "listings"."built_year" BETWEEN 1800 AND 2200)

listings_residential_fields.name: listings_residential_fields
listings_residential_fields.value: "listings"."type" NOT IN ('condo','house','townhouse','pool_villa') OR ("listings"."beds" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."baths" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."size_sqm" IS NOT NULL)

listings_house_land.name: listings_house_land
listings_house_land.value: "listings"."type" NOT IN ('house','townhouse','pool_villa') OR "listings"."land_sqwah" IS NOT NULL

listings_land_fields.name: listings_land_fields
listings_land_fields.value: "listings"."type" <> 'land' OR ("listings"."land_sqwah" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."beds" IS NULL AND "listings"."baths" IS NULL AND "listings"."size_sqm" IS NULL)

listings_condo_fields.name: listings_condo_fields
listings_condo_fields.value: "listings"."type" = 'condo' OR ("listings"."foreign_quota" IS NULL AND "listings"."common_fee_per_sqm" IS NULL AND "listings"."floor" IS NULL)

listings_land_details.name: listings_land_details
listings_land_details.value: "listings"."type" = 'land' OR ("listings"."land_zoning" IS NULL AND "listings"."road_frontage_m" IS NULL AND "listings"."title_deed" IS NULL)

listings_hotel_fields.name: listings_hotel_fields
listings_hotel_fields.value: ("listings"."type" = 'hotel' AND "listings"."hotel_rooms" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."hotel_rooms" > 0 AND ("listings"."hotel_occupancy" IS NULL OR "listings"."hotel_occupancy" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND ("listings"."hotel_annual_revenue" IS NULL OR "listings"."hotel_annual_revenue" >= 0)) OR ("listings"."type" <> 'hotel' AND "listings"."hotel_rooms" IS NULL AND "listings"."hotel_occupancy" IS NULL AND "listings"."hotel_annual_revenue" IS NULL AND "listings"."hotel_license" IS NULL)

locations_coordinates.name: locations_coordinates
locations_coordinates.value: ("locations"."lat" IS NULL AND "locations"."lng" IS NULL) OR ("locations"."lat" IS NOT NULL AND "locations"."lng" IS NOT NULL AND "locations"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "locations"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

locations_parent_shape.name: locations_parent_shape
locations_parent_shape.value: ("locations"."level" = 'province' AND "locations"."parent_id" IS NULL) OR ("locations"."level" <> 'province' AND "locations"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL)

osm_places_coordinates.name: osm_places_coordinates
osm_places_coordinates.value: ("osm_places"."lat" IS NULL AND "osm_places"."lng" IS NULL) OR ("osm_places"."lat" IS NOT NULL AND "osm_places"."lng" IS NOT NULL AND "osm_places"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "osm_places"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

projects_numeric_bounds.name: projects_numeric_bounds
projects_numeric_bounds.value: ("projects"."price_from" IS NULL OR "projects"."price_from" > 0) AND ("projects"."total_units" IS NULL OR "projects"."total_units" >= 0) AND ("projects"."completion_year" IS NULL OR "projects"."completion_year" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2200) AND ("projects"."progress_pct" IS NULL OR "projects"."progress_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

projects_publish_required.name: projects_publish_required
projects_publish_required.value: "projects"."publish_state" <> 'published' OR ("projects"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."description_th" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."description_en" IS NOT NULL)

stations_coordinates.name: stations_coordinates
stations_coordinates.value: ("stations"."lat" IS NULL AND "stations"."lng" IS NULL) OR ("stations"."lat" IS NOT NULL AND "stations"."lng" IS NOT NULL AND "stations"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "stations"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

unit_types_bounds.name: unit_types_bounds
unit_types_bounds.value: "unit_types"."beds" >= 0 AND "unit_types"."baths" > 0 AND "unit_types"."size_sqm" > 0 AND ("unit_types"."price_from" IS NULL OR "unit_types"."price_from" > 0) AND "unit_types"."total" >= 0 AND "unit_types"."available" BETWEEN 0 AND "unit_types"."total"
